title: OpenID Connect (SSO)
description: Single sign-on via an OIDC provider (Keycloak, Authentik, Google, Microsoft, etc.)
allowedGroupsHint: Members of these groups log in with the user role. Admin and moderator groups need not be listed here again. Only members of a user, admin or moderator group may log in; if all three are empty, nobody can.
adminGroupsHint: Users in these groups are created as admins
moderatorGroupsHint: Users in these groups are created as moderators
